### Version 0.1.197
- Fix HPOS wc_get_orders query for specialized virtual fulfillment tabs (warranty, redeem, endorsement) by querying order IDs via direct SQL
- Exclude parent orders with _has_warranty_claim from displaying in the Warranty Claims fulfillment tab
- Enforce client-side filtering safeguard in OrderTable and getOrderRma to ensure only authentic warranty replacement items are shown
